strings.name: Manuel Neuer
strings.summary: Neuer progressed through Schalke's academy and joined Bayern Munich in 2011. His combination of saves, interceptions outside the penalty area and distribution made him a leading exponent of the sweeper-keeper role. He won the 2014 World Cup with Germany and two European trebles with Bayern. Injuries interrupted his playing career, but in 2026 he extended his Bayern contract and returned to the World Cup.
